thesis: Ali from Cairo changes lethal damage into survival at one life, creating a fragile but memorable shield that asks whether the opponent can remove the creature before finishing the game.

competitiveTimeline.significance: Although never a broad tournament pillar, Ali became one of Arabian Nights’ most famous rules curiosities and an enduring collector and Old School conversation piece.

playbook.role: Deploy Ali when burn or combat damage is the opponent’s primary route to victory and protect it with countermagic or removal. Its four toughness matters only until the first clean answer.
